description:
Set the blend mode of the active layer.

`COLOR` is the Photoshop UI name (Colorize); it is mapped to ExtendScript `BlendMode.COLORBLEND`.

blendMode.description: Blend mode (Photoshop UI name). COLOR maps to BlendMode.COLORBLEND. DARKERCOLOR / LIGHTERCOLOR use Action Manager if the DOM enum is missing.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_set_layer_blend_mode
